capabilities: Create notes from web URLs via clipboard, ribbon, context menu or batch commands
Parse content from websites, YouTube, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest and other services
Render notes from per-content-type templates with variables and filters
Download article images into a vault folder
Expose an API for other plugins to invoke its functionality
extras: Image downloading from articles is supported only on desktop. The README lists supported content types ordered by URL detection priority.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive web pages or posts from services like YouTube, X, Bluesky or Mastodon into editable notes.

relations.evidence: Will be parsed to readable form using Mozilla Readability and then converted to markdown.

requires.name: Google API key for extended YouTube data

summary: Web clipper that saves articles, videos and social media posts from a URL or clipboard as templated Markdown notes in the vault.
